0.name: The Hollow Saint
0.quote: The body was opened and found empty, save for the sound of distant bells.

resource.name: Thrall
resource.rule: Thralls act as temporary HP which must be depleted before the Hollow Saint can take damage.

first_draft_actions.description: Gain 1 Presence after resolving the Action.

second_draft_actions.description: Deal 2 Damage to the player holding the lowest value die.
Deal 2 Damage to the player holding the highest value die.
Deal 1 Damage to the first player holding a 1 or a 3.
Add 1 thrall and 1 Doom.
Deal 3 Damage to the player with the highest total drafted dice.
Deal 2 Damage to every player and add 1 Doom.

0.doom_rule: When Doom fills, add 3 thralls, then reset Doom.

1.name: The Pale Mourner
1.quote: Those who heard her weeping reported dreams of cities drowned beneath a black sun

first_draft_actions.description: If any Ward was generated this round, recover 1 Presence.

second_draft_actions.description: Deal 2 Damage to the first player.
Deal 3 Damage to the first player who generated Ward this round. If none did, add 1 Doom.
Recover 1 Presence for each Ward generated this round, to a maximum of 3, then add 1 Doom.
Recover 2 Presence and add 1 Doom.
Deal 3 Damage to the first player who generated no Ward this round.
Deal 1 Damage to every player, ignoring Ward.

1.doom_rule: When Doom fills, deal 1 Damage to every player.

2.name: The Crooked King
2.quote: No record names the kingdom, yet several witnesses insist they once served beneath its crown.

first_draft_actions.description: Add 1 Doom after resolving the Action.
Gain 1 Presence after resolving the Action.

second_draft_actions.description: Deal 2 Damage to the first player.
Add 2 Doom.
Deal 2 Damage to the first player whose drafted dice total 7 or more.
Add 1 Doom, then recover 1 Presence for each 2 Doom currently on the track.
Deal 2 Damage to the first player with matching dice.
Deal Damage equal to current Doom to the first player in draft order, then remove 2 Doom.

2.doom_rule: When Doom fills, deal 2 Damage to every player, ignoring Ward. Then reset Doom to 0.

progression.ascended: All Damage +2, +1 Doom to all Actions.

3.name: The Glass Prophet
3.quote: The specimen spoke only once. Thereafter, every clock in the room ran backward.

first_draft_actions.description: Until the end of the round, all players treat Left Hand as Right Hand and Right Hand as Left Hand.
Until the end of the round, players may not regain hit points.
Recover 1 Presence after resolving the Action.

second_draft_actions.description: Deal 2 Damage to the first player in draft order.
Deal 2 Damage to the first player with L < R.
Add 2 Doom.
Deal 2 Damage to the first player with matching dice; miss if none.
Deal 3 Damage to the first player whose drafted dice total 8 or more.
Deal 1 Damage to every player, then add 1 Doom.

3.doom_rule: When Doom fills, deal 1 Damage to every player and recover 3 Presence, then reset Doom.

progression.ascended: All Damage +1 and every Action that adds Doom adds +1 additional Doom.

0.name: The Black Well
0.rule: Each player may lose 1 HP. For each player who does, remove 1 Doom and recover 1 HP to another player.

1.name: The Blood Offering
1.rule: One player loses 2 HP. Remove 3 Doom.

2.name: The Wayside Shrine
2.rule: Choose one: remove 2 Doom or each player recovers 1 HP.

0.rule_face_up: After the first draft pass each round, reroll the remaining dice.

1.rule_face_up: Once per round, one player may treat one drafted die as ±1 for their action only.

3.rule_face_up: During even numbered rounds, players cannot generate Ward.

4.rule_face_up: After the first draft pass each round, the First Player must select and reroll one undrafted die.

5.rule_face_up: At the end of each round, if no player took Damage, add 1 Doom.
